item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - 2026 GRAMMY Backstage Live on Shorts
item.description:
Hello, I've been looking for this specific video from The 68th Annual Grammy Awards back on February 2nd. The original video has been privated on GRAMMYs official YouTube, and I'm just wondering if anyone has a copy of this specific video. It essentially contains the backstage camera of the awards ceremony. I've tried looking for this on the Wayback Machine and other URLs, but to no avail.

Please, I would greatly appreciate getting a copy of this for my archive. Thank you.
item.author: redformurder
